title: Perfect height, bad handles
text:
Perfect height, bad handles. It is the perfect height for a 3.5yr old. Very sturdy & the lady bugs/bright colors are super cute. The 1 thing that could be improved is the fold/carry design. It pinches your fingers if you try to use the 2 cut out handles to fold-up or carry. It hurts me, an adult, so I definitely will not let 3.5yr old carry or fold this.
Correct that design & I would give 5 stars
